claims.claim: Blue Customised Ps4 slim with 10 latest games.
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue PS4 Slim and a “10” graphic on the box, but no game discs/cases or proof of installed/packaged games.

claims.claim: Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.
claims.evidence: No FIFA/PES game discs, cases, or screenshots of the game library are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals, warranty stickers, internal inspection, or any evidence of opening/rework.
No temperature/usage test, fan noise recording, or gameplay session screenshot is provided.
Photos do not clearly show the ports, and no demonstration is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No original accessories (“pads”/cables/charging/HDMI) or UK receipt is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Games claim may be false or exaggerated (no discs/cases or installed library proof shown).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (or close-up of game discs/cases) matching the “10” claim.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used PS4 Slim console only (no guaranteed games).

risks.risk: “All ports working” may be incorrect (HDMI/USB ports can fail).
risks.proof: Video showing the console powered on with HDMI display plus testing USB ports (plug/unplug a controller/USB device) and showing it working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for ports; treat as worst-case for functionality until tested.

risks.risk: Overheating/fan issues may exist (common with older PS4 units).
risks.proof: Short gameplay or stress test clip (10–15 minutes) with fan sound visible and no shutdown; optionally a temperature readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service (worst-case cooling concern).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” may be untrue (could be refurbished/repasted).
risks.proof: Photos of warranty/serial stickers and any seal labels (front/back/underside) plus a close-up of the serial/model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/refurb risk (do not assume pristine condition).

risks.risk: Accessories/receipt may be missing (seller claims original pads and UK receipt, but none shown).
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out (HDMI cable, power cable, controller(s), charging/USB cable, manuals) and a clear photo of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controllers only (no receipt/accessories assumed).

proof_requests: Photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (confirm the exact 10 titles).
Video test: power on + HDMI output working + USB ports tested (controller/USB device).
Short gameplay/stress test clip to confirm no overheating/shutdown.
Clear close-up of the console serial/model label (and any seals/warranty stickers).
Photo of all included accessories laid out + clear photo of the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm a blue PS4 Slim and two camo-style controllers, but the key value drivers (the “10 latest games”, port functionality, overheating status, and included accessories/receipt) are not verifiable from the images. To price safely, you need proof of games and functional testing.
